nodes.Head: Independent head and hair geometry. Pivots at neck. Small yaw/pitch only.
nodes.Torso: Separate cropped Polo bust, no full body or ball shoulders.
nodes.EyeLeft: Image-left independent sclera and lids; do not rotate this for gaze.
nodes.GazeLeft: Independent iris/pupil assembly; rotation.y horizontal ±0.22, rotation.x vertical ±0.14.
nodes.HandLeft: Independent image-left hand, pivot at wrist, posed around Apple.
nodes.HandRight: Independent image-right hand, pivot at wrist, posed around Phone.
nodes.Apple: Whole solid apple group with stem/leaf; move entire group for toss and catch.
nodes.BreadWhole: Solid toast with crust and crumb; visible initial bread version.
nodes.BreadBitten: Alternate solid toast with actual scalloped bite opening. Same transform and pivot as BreadWhole. Hide at load.
nodes.Phone: Solid phone with back cameras, display and physical side thickness.
nodes.Flash: Mesh light source, child of Phone. Hide at load; briefly show for phone-flash action.
nodes.LabelCoder: Curved paper sticker/text CODER; child of Head.
nodes.LabelMusician: Curved paper sticker/text MUSICIAN; child of Head.
nodes.LabelChristian: Curved paper sticker/text CHRISTIAN; child of Head.
nodes.LabelDreamer: Curved paper sticker/text DREAMER; child of Head.
nodes.LabelWork: Curved paper sticker/text WORK; child of Head.
nodes.LabelVideo: Curved physical VIDEO CREATOR sticker, child of Head
nodes.TeethUpper: Independent warm ivory upper teeth arc, child of MouthOpen; silly/grin show, wow hide
nodes.MouthOpen: Independent cavity/lips group, child of Head; hidden for neutral
nodes.Tongue: Tongue mesh, child of MouthOpen; show for silly only

runtime.bread: Toggle BreadWhole/BreadBitten together after a short move towards mouth; avoid visible duplicate mesh.
runtime.flash: Flash is a Phone child and uses emissive material; set visible=true for 80–120ms.
runtime.labels: Each Label* group is a mesh interaction anchor; text and paper remain children. Raycast group descendants and focus world-position bounds.
runtime.limitations: Single-view inferred head, front ±30° camera. No claimed full 360° or production facial rig.
runtime.openLids: LidLeft/Right visible=false while blink amount<.01; absolute scale.y=.001+(1-.001)*amount when closing.
runtime.breadParent: Bread variants are Head children to preserve physical lip-corner contact.
